description: SEMANTIC search over the vetted blueprint catalog — matches are ranked by what you MEAN, not by shared words, so describe the capability in plain language ('rewards for repeat customers' finds the loyalty blueprint). RUN THIS FIRST — before creating custom tables or hand-rolling a capability: blueprints ship working FUNCTIONALITY (gift cards, loyalty, payment surfaces, carts), not just screen layouts. Search once per FEATURE you're adding (smart grid, gift cards, loyalty points, receipts) and REPEAT it for each distinct capability rather than issuing one broad query — a build usually combines several. Returns { results, note? }: blueprint summaries (id, slot, title, summary, surfaces, tags, selfPersisting, match score in [0,1]) best match first. selfPersisting: true means the blueprint reads/writes its OWN custom tables by exact name inside its code, and apply_blueprint_widgets provisions them in your organization automatically (extension-owned ones come from installing that extension) — NEVER create a table for a feature it covers. Prefer this over list_blueprints when you know what you need. Pick the widgets you need and copy them with apply_blueprint_widgets({ flowId, picks }) — applied ON TOP of the current build, never replacing it. Low match scores across the board mean no vetted blueprint fits — only then build that piece from scratch grounded in the command-frame docs. Optional `slot`/`surface` narrow the results; `limit` caps how many are returned (default 10).
name: flow_search_blueprints
title: Search the blueprint catalog
